Her poems have appeared in Best American Poetry, The Academy of American Poets’ Poem-a-Day series, Verse Daily, and in such journals as American Poetry Review, Beloit Poetry Journal, The Collagist, Green Mountains Review, Poet Lore, and Rattle. A graduate of The MFA Program for Writers at Warren Wilson College, she teaches at Montpelier High School and lives in Plainfield, Vermont.
